description: Graphite sketch of an abstract/half completed face. The face is contained within a large rectangle, the rectangle is surrounded by a border of negative space. The face, which fills the entire space inside the rectangle, is turned towards the right side of the paper. On the side of the face closest to the right side of the paper one eye and a line delineating the mouth contrast with the other side of the face which is blank. The curvature of the jaw is the focus of the drawing, it is the boldest and strongest line in the work.
